headline: No active severe weather warning for Maharashtra coast. Moderate sea state expected.
body_text: The sea conditions off the Maharashtra coast (Ratnagiri, Malvan, Sindhudurg districts) are characterized by moderate wave heights of 1.2–2.0 m. Southwesterly winds at 15–25 knots. No active storm systems in the North Arabian Sea within 500 km of the coast. Fishing operations may proceed with normal caution.
